assembly_summary: Original11-stroke crouched tiger selected jointly with the lying source before keys. Native head and eye marks follow the observed three-quarter-to-frontal turn; native striped body and folded paws hold. Hidden tail is cropped rather than invented.
review_note: 2 independent blind still review round(s). Source framing/pose: not met; original doodle identity: met. The late sampled drawing does not clearly arrive at the source's frontal head pose. The head shifts and narrows, but its small left ear, large pointed right ear, eye marks and projecting right cheek retain essentially the starting orientation. No actual normal-speed playback approval, recognition classifier or verified planted-contact gate. No training ran.
